import pytest
from calendar_core.slots import Event, overlaps, free_slots, parse_time, fmt_duration


def test_issue_back_to_back_no_overlap():
    """Back-to-back events (one ends exactly when the next starts) do not overlap."""
    a = Event(540, 600)  # 9*60=540, 10*60=600
    b = Event(600, 660)  # 10*60=600, 11*60=660
    assert overlaps(a, b) is False  # [540,600) and [600,660) share 0 minutes -> False


def test_issue_back_to_back_reversed():
    """Back-to-back events (one ends exactly when the next starts) do not overlap."""
    a = Event(600, 660)  # 10*60=600, 11*60=660
    b = Event(540, 600)  # 9*60=540, 10*60=600
    assert overlaps(a, b) is False  # [600,660) and [540,600) share 0 minutes -> False


def test_issue_adjacent_single_minute_no_overlap():
    """Back-to-back events (one ends exactly when the next starts) do not overlap."""
    a = Event(600, 601)  # 10*60=600, 600+1=601
    b = Event(601, 602)  # 600+1=601, 600+2=602
    assert overlaps(a, b) is False  # [600,601) and [601,602) share 0 minutes -> False


def test_issue_one_minute_overlap():
    """Two events overlap only if they share at least one minute."""
    a = Event(540, 601)  # 9*60=540, 10*60+1=601
    b = Event(600, 660)  # 10*60=600, 11*60=660
    assert overlaps(a, b) is True  # share minute 600 (601-600=1 minute) -> True


def test_issue_identical_events_overlap():
    """Identical events share at least one minute and must still overlap."""
    a = Event(540, 600)  # 9*60=540, 10*60=600
    b = Event(540, 600)  # 9*60=540, 10*60=600
    assert overlaps(a, b) is True  # share 600-540=60 minutes -> True


def test_issue_contained_event_overlaps():
    """One event fully inside another shares a minute and must still overlap."""
    a = Event(540, 660)  # 9*60=540, 11*60=660
    b = Event(560, 580)  # 9*60+20=560, 9*60+40=580
    assert overlaps(a, b) is True  # inner [560,580) inside [540,660), share 20 minutes -> True


def test_issue_back_to_back_no_gap_in_free_slots():
    """free_slots returns the gaps inside [day_start, day_end) not covered by any event."""
    events = [Event(540, 600), Event(600, 660)]  # 9*60=540, 10*60=600, 11*60=660
    assert free_slots(events, 540, 660) == []  # 540=9*60, 660=11*60, union covers all so no gap


def test_contract_disjoint_no_overlap():
    """Two events overlap only if they share at least one minute."""
    a = Event(540, 550)  # 9*60=540, 9*60+10=550
    b = Event(560, 570)  # 9*60+20=560, 9*60+30=570
    assert overlaps(a, b) is False  # gap 560-550=10 minutes, share 0 minutes -> False


def test_contract_free_slots_unsorted_input_sorted_gaps():
    """Events may arrive in any order and gaps are returned sorted by start."""
    events = [Event(600, 660), Event(540, 560)]  # 10*60=600, 11*60=660, 9*60=540, 9*60+20=560
    assert free_slots(events, 540, 660) == [(560, 600)]  # 560=9*60+20, 600=10*60, gap 600-560=40


def test_contract_free_slots_clipped_to_day():
    """Events partly outside the day are clipped to it."""
    events = [Event(500, 560)]  # 8*60+20=500, 9*60+20=560
    assert free_slots(events, 540, 660) == [(560, 660)]  # 540=9*60, 560=9*60+20, 660=11*60


def test_contract_free_slots_min_minutes_filters_small_gap():
    """Only gaps of at least min_minutes are returned."""
    events = [Event(540, 590), Event(600, 660)]  # 9*60=540, 9*60+50=590, 10*60=600, 11*60=660
    assert free_slots(events, 540, 660, min_minutes=11) == []  # gap 600-590=10 < 11 so filtered


def test_contract_parse_time_valid():
    """parse_time turns "HH:MM" (24-hour) into minutes."""
    assert parse_time("09:00") == 540  # 9*60+0=540


def test_contract_parse_time_invalid():
    """Anything it cannot parse raises ValueError."""
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):  # unparsable text has no minute value -> ValueError
        parse_time("nope")


def test_contract_fmt_duration():
    """fmt_duration renders "Xh YYm" (e.g. 65 -> "1h 05m")."""
    assert fmt_duration(65) == "1h 05m"  # 65//60=1, 65%60=5 -> "1h 05m"
